# The Writing Desk

> UK's longest established fountain pen specialists offering custom nibs, pen repairs, vintage collections, and expert restoration services.

The Writing Desk is a specialist retailer based in Bury St Edmunds with deep expertise in fountain pens, serving collectors and enthusiasts with new pens, vintage finds, custom nib services, and professional pen repairs. The site provides comprehensive resources including guides, FAQs, and a blog dedicated to pen maintenance and selection.

## Key Topics

## Shop & Products

- [Fountain Pens, Ballpoint Pens, Rollerballs](https://www.thewritingdesk.co.uk/pens): Main pen shop catalog featuring fountain pens, ballpoints and rollerballs.
- [New Arrivals](https://www.thewritingdesk.co.uk/new): New arrivals in fountain pens from major brands.
- [Vintage and Collectable Used Pens](https://www.thewritingdesk.co.uk/pens/used-pens): Vintage and collectable used pens from specialist dealers.
- [Pen Nibs](https://www.thewritingdesk.co.uk/pens/pen-nibs): Wide range of genuine replacement nibs for fountain pens.
- [Converters & Spare Parts](https://www.thewritingdesk.co.uk/pens/converters-pen-spares): Ink converters and spare parts for major fountain pen brands.

## Custom Services & Repairs

- [Custom Nibs](https://www.thewritingdesk.co.uk/pens/custom-nibs): Custom nib services including stub, italic and oblique grinding.
- [Pen Repairs and Servicing](https://www.thewritingdesk.co.uk/content/repairs-and-servicing.html): FAQ on pen repairs, servicing and nib restoration services.
- [Testimonials](https://www.thewritingdesk.co.uk/module/blockshopreviews/testimonials): Customer testimonials and reviews of pen repair and restoration services.
